novelty.justification: The novel hypothesis is that grammatical-gender priors "leak across languages—contaminating even genderless-language (e.g., English) or neutral-context outputs" and that a causal residual-stream gender direction mediates this semantic contamination. Searches around "grammatical gender multilingual LLM residual stream causal intervention," "grammatical gender cross-lingual leakage English," and "grammatical gender semantic associations language models" identify the closest work as Large Language Models Share Representations of Latent Grammatical Concepts Across Typologically Diverse Languages (2025), which already finds shared grammatical-gender features and causally ablates or steers them, alongside Grammatical gender associations outweigh topical gender bias in crosslinguistic word embeddings (2020), which already connects grammatical gender to semantic association geometry. Moving from those results to language-conditioned adjective bias and carryover into genderless-language outputs is a substantive multi-step integration and new operationalized relationship, but it is a natural extension of existing grammatical-feature intervention, cross-lingual representation, and linguistic-relativity work rather than a wholly new mechanistic paradigm.
